expanded_sentences: The patient is a 47-year-old female diagnosed with metastatic hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer.
She has been experiencing mild, ongoing fatigue related to her cancer treatment.
Initially, she was diagnosed with invasive ductal carcinoma of the left breast at age 45.
Liver lesions consistent with metastatic disease were identified at age 46.
The breast carcinoma is classified as Stage IV with TNM staging of T3, N1, M1.
A core biopsy of the breast confirmed invasive ductal carcinoma.
A liver biopsy confirmed metastatic breast carcinoma.
Tumor profiling revealed a PIK3CA mutation, which is relevant for targeted treatment.
The patient is currently receiving fulvestrant intramuscularly and palbociclib orally.
An MRI was performed on February 18, 2026.
CA 15-3 levels were elevated at 86.4 units per milliliter during progression assessment.
The patient's maternal aunt had breast cancer at age 52.
